    target = max(-16, min(16, 0.65*b))

    if r['obs']['status'] in ('PINNED','JACKKNIFED','FINISHED','TIME_UP','DNF'):
        break

import math
for i in range(14):
    o = observe()
    if o['status'] in ('FINISHED','TIME_UP','DNF','JACKKNIFED','PINNED'):
        break
    rails = o['local_map']
    fits = []
    for name in ('left_rail','right_rail'):
        pts = rails[name]
        n = len(pts)
        x = sum(p[0] for p in pts)/n
        y = sum(p[1] for p in pts)/n
        m = sum((p[0]-x)*(p[1]-y) for p in pts)/sum((p[0]-x)**2 for p in pts)
        fits.append((m,y-m*x))
    slope = sum(p[0] for p in fits)/2
    offset = sum(p[1] for p in fits)/2
    heading = math.degrees(math.atan(slope))
    target = max(-14,min(14,1.4*heading+8*offset))
    steer = max(-30,min(30,2.4*o['hitch_deg']-1.65*target))
    r = drive(steer,-0.5,0.8)
    print(i,round(heading,1),round(offset,2),round(o['hitch_deg'],1),round(steer,1),r['obs']['status'])
    if r['result'].get('contact'):
        break
print(report())

    for i in range(16):

        drive(steer, -step, 1.8)
        print(round(observe()['progress']['remaining'], 2), round(observe()['hitch_deg'], 2))
except LegOver:
    pass
print(report())
